payload_detail: 4,998 packs of Belarusian-stamped cigarettes, over EUR 27,500 incl. taxes
source_title: VSAT: Druskininkų pasieniečiai nutupdė keturis iš Baltarusijos įskridusius dronus
quote: Druskininkų pasieniečiai naktį vienu kartu nutupdė keturis iš Baltarusijos įskridusius dronus su nelegalių rūkalų kroviniais. Iš viso buvo gabenama 5 tūkst. pakelių baltarusiškų cigarečių, pranešė Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
quote_translation: Druskininkai border guards at night landed four drones flying in from Belarus with illegal cigarette loads in one go. In total about 5,000 packs of Belarusian cigarettes were being carried, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reported.

summary: Drone carrying a suspect package toward the Central Prisons was detected by the anti-drone system and seized with its load before reaching its destination. Authorities did not disclose the contents.
source_title: Ασφυξία με αριθμούς στις Κεντρικές Φυλακές - Η Σημερινή
quote: Drone που μετέφερε ύποπτο πακέτο προς τις Κεντρικές Φυλακές εντοπίστηκε από το σύστημα anti-drone και κατασχέθηκε, μαζί με το φορτίο του, πριν φθάσει στον προορισμό του.
quote_translation: A drone carrying a suspect package toward the Central Prisons was detected by the anti-drone system and seized, with its load, before reaching its destination.

summary: Border guards used counter-drone equipment to bring down a drone flying from the Belarus border inland in Šalčininkai district. Its bundle held 200 packs of NZ Gold cigarettes with Belarusian stamps worth EUR 1,102. Administrative proceedings opened at Purvėnai post.
payload_detail: 200 packs NZ Gold cigarettes, EUR 1,102 incl. taxes
source_title: Sekmadienį VSAT pareigūnai nutupdė kontrabandines cigaretes skraidinusį droną
quote: Sekmadienį pasieniečiai Šalčininkų rajone perėmė bepilotį orlaivį, gabenusį kontrabandą – 200 pakelių cigarečių, praneša Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
quote_translation: On Sunday border guards in Šalčininkai district intercepted an unmanned aircraft carrying contraband, 200 packs of cigarettes, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reports.

summary: Drone snagged on a floodlight of module 6 at Picassent prison carrying two smartphones, SIM cards and chargers; Guardia Civil investigating.
payload_detail: two smartphones, SIM cards, chargers
source_title: Interceptan un dron con el que trataban de introducir dos teléfonos inteligentes en la cárcel de Picassent, Valencia
quote: Los funcionarios entregaron inmediatamente el dron a la Guardia Civil que ha iniciado una investigación para tratar de determinar el origen de la aeronave y los posibles destinatarios de la entrega.
quote_translation: Staff handed the drone to the Guardia Civil, which has opened an investigation into its origin and recipients.

summary: Suspected drone approached Diavata prison at night; external guards activated the anti-drone system, control of the drone was cut. Authorities are examining whether it carried phones or drugs and are searching for its operators.
source_title: Συναγερμός στις Φυλακές Διαβατών: Drone επιχείρησε να προσεγγίσει τις πτέρυγες κρατουμένων - HappenedNow.gr
quote: Το μη επανδρωμένο αεροσκάφος εντοπίστηκε από στελέχη της Εξωτερικής Φρουράς, τα οποία ενεργοποίησαν άμεσα το ειδικό σύστημα anti-drone.
quote_translation: The unmanned aircraft was detected by External Guard staff, who immediately activated the special anti-drone system.

summary: Drone approaching the exercise yards of Chania prison was neutralised by the anti-drone system and fell near a watchtower. A bag it had dropped on a roof held phones, routers, SIM cards and climbing and cutting tools. An inmate climbing to collect it was stopped.
payload_detail: 5 phones, 2 routers, 3 SIM cards, 20 m rope, 5 saw blades, knife, metal cutter, carabiner
source_title: Φυλακές Χανίων: Το drone με τη σακούλα δεν έφθασε στο προαύλιο – Τι περιείχε
quote: Ειδικότερα, προσωπικό της Υπηρεσίας Εξωτερικής Φρούρησης, που εκτελούσε διατεταγμένη υπηρεσία στο σωφρονιστικό κατάστημα, εντόπισε απογευματινές ώρες του Σαββάτου το εν λόγω drone να προσεγγίζει τις εγκαταστάσεις με κατεύθυνση προς τους χώρους προαυλισμού.
quote_translation: Specifically, external guard staff on duty at the prison spotted, on Saturday afternoon, the drone approaching the facilities heading for the exercise yards.

summary: Prison police at Gazzi intercepted a drone flying near cell windows with drugs, phones and chargers; drone and load seized.
source_title: Drone carico di droga e cellulari arriva al carcere di Gazzi ma viene intercettato - Tempostretto

quote_translation: A drone loaded with drugs and phones was intercepted by Messina prison police officers last Friday.

place: Sanlúcar de Barrameda (Cádiz), rooftop on seafront
summary: El Debate reporters filming in Sanlúcar de Barrameda were watched with thermal cameras and drones operated from the roof of the tallest seafront building, which interrupted an interview. The outlet says authorities describe this as frequent practice by drug traffickers.
source_title: En vídeo | Así acosaron los narcos a los reporteros de El Debate: chivatazos, drones y fotos por WhatsApp
quote: Según comentan las autoridades, es un recurso frecuentemente utilizado por los narcotraficantes, que controlan todo el paisaje desde la azotea de un alto edificio situado en primera línea de playa.
quote_translation: According to the authorities, it is a resource frequently used by drug traffickers, who control the whole landscape from the roof of a tall building on the seafront.

place: Alhaurín de la Torre prison, Málaga
summary: Prison staff found a small remote-controlled aircraft that had dropped over 1 kg of hashish inside the grounds; the drone was located in an inmate's cell. The inmate was questioned and a report sent to the duty court. The person flying it had not been identified.
payload_detail: more than 1 kg hashish
source_title: Manhunt after drone caught dropping 1kg of drugs into Alhaurin de la Torre prison
quote: The operation took place at Alhaurin de la Torre prison, where staff discovered a small remote-controlled aircraft that had allegedly been used to deliver the drugs to an inmate.

summary: Gendarmes alerted around 02:30 caught two men in flagrante delicto piloting drones to deliver parcels to Mulhouse-Lutterbach prison; Mulhouse court convicted both on 3 June 2026 to unsuspended prison terms.
source_title: Mulhouse : deux hommes condamnés pour livraisons par drone au CP de Lutterbach
quote: Le tribunal judiciaire de Mulhouse a condamné le 3 juin 2026 deux hommes
quote_translation: Mulhouse judicial court on 3 June 2026 convicted two men.

summary: Besançon police intercepted a drone delivering a small parcel on a cord to the remand prison overnight; a 28-year-old woman was arrested.
source_title: Besançon : un drone surpris en pleine livraison à la prison, une femme de 28 ans interpellée
quote: Les policiers bisontins ont surpris une livraison de colis par drone
quote_translation: Besançon police caught a parcel delivery by drone.

summary: Policía Nacional Operation HORUS dismantled a network in Cádiz and Álava using fixed-wing drones to carry hashish and cocaine from Morocco; eight arrested, one drone, 40 kg hashish, 2 kg cocaine and EUR 14,000 seized.
payload_detail: 40 kg hashish and 2 kg cocaine seized
source_title: Así operaba la red de narcotráfico que usaba drones para transportar hachís y cocaína desde Marruecos - Infobae
quote: El grupo utilizaba drones de ala fija, aeronaves no tripuladas de gran autonomía, para transportar alijos de hachís y cocaína desde Marruecos, cruzando el estrecho de Gibraltar por vía aérea hasta territorio español.
quote_translation: The group used fixed-wing drones, long-endurance unmanned aircraft, to carry consignments of hashish and cocaine from Morocco, crossing the Strait of Gibraltar by air into Spanish territory.

summary: Two mobile phones were seized inside Grasse prison; one reportedly introduced by drone at night.
payload_detail: 2 phones seized, one reportedly via drone
source_title: Alpes-Maritimes : ils tentent de faire entrer en prison des téléphones en les cachant dans des colis de poulet - CNews

quote_translation: On Wednesday 27 May, two phones were seized inside Grasse prison itself. One of them was reportedly introduced by drone in the middle of the night.

summary: Police patrol at about 00:40 found two men and a woman with a flight-ready drone near the prison, carrying a package with mobile phones and a suspected drug-soaked paper. Drone and contraband seized.
payload_detail: package with mobile phones and a 'drogenverdächtiges Papier'
source_title: Gefängnis Neuruppin-Wulkow: Polizei stoppt Drogenschmuggel per Drohne

quote_translation: A patrol spotted two men and a woman with a flight-ready drone near the prison at about 00:40, a police spokesperson said.

summary: Gendarmes arrested two young men in a park, one holding a drone controller; a drone carrying cigarettes, cannabis resin and herb was found in the prison car park. Three men convicted 27 July 2026; the organiser was an inmate.
payload_detail: five packs of cigarettes, 200 g cannabis resin, 100 g cannabis herb
source_title: Ils avaient tenté de « livrer » de la drogue en prison avec un drone, trois hommes condamnés dans la Vienne - Ouest-France
quote: En mai, ils avaient tenté de faire passer de la drogue au sein du centre pénitentiaire de la ville grâce à un drone. Le commanditaire de l’opération est un détenu de la prison.
quote_translation: In May they had tried to get drugs into the city's prison using a drone. The operation's instigator is an inmate of the prison.

summary: Spanish National Police dismantled a network using large four-motor fixed-wing drones (about 20 kg per crossing) to move hashish and cocaine from Morocco to Spain for onward supply to France; eight arrested, one drone, 40 kg hashish, 2 kg cocaine seized.
payload_detail: hashish and cocaine, up to 20 kg per crossing; seized 40 kg hashish, 2 kg cocaine
source_title: Trafic de drogue par drone : un réseau international démantelé entre le Maroc, l’Espagne et la France - Maroc Hebdo

quote_translation: Spanish national police announced it dismantled an international criminal organisation using heavy-lift drones to carry drugs from Morocco to Spain, before transfer to France.

summary: Police dismantled an organisation using drones to bring large quantities of hashish from Morocco into Spain; one aircraft intercepted: four metres, four motors, 100 km/h.
payload_detail: large quantities of hashish
source_title: Así es el dron que unos narcotraficantes utilizaban para introducir droga en España - El Periódico
quote: La Policía ha desarticulado una organización que utilizaba drones para introducir en España grandes cantidades de hachís desde Marruecos.
quote_translation: Police have dismantled an organisation that used drones to bring large quantities of hashish into Spain from Morocco.

quote_translation: Three young people prosecuted in Poitiers on Friday 23 October had made 77 drone deliveries between May and July 2026 to several prisons in the Centre-Ouest.

summary: Police arrested two Brindisi men, aged 29 and 32, in a car near the Lecce Tangenziale Est PIP zone after the prison's detection system flagged a drone; about 1 kg hashish, phones and fishing line found.
payload_detail: about 552 g and 506 g hashish, three smartphones, USB cables
source_title: Drone con droga e cellulari diretto al carcere, due arresti - RaiNews
quote: L'ispezione dell'area circostante ha permesso di rinvenire due pochette contenenti: circa 552 grammi di hashish (divisi in panetti interi e frazionati), due cavi USB e uno smartphone
quote_translation: Inspection of the surrounding area found two pouches containing about 552 grams of hashish (whole and split blocks), two USB cables and one smartphone.

summary: Prison police intercepted a drone loaded with phones bound for Poggioreale and arrested the pilot, a 28-year-old from the Salerno area, tried by fast-track procedure.
source_title: Trovato drone che portava cellulari al carcere di Poggioreale, ma questa volta il pilota è stato arrestato - Fanpage
quote: La polizia penitenziaria dell'istituto detentivo è riuscita ad arrestare chi pilotava il drone, un 28enne del Salernitano, già processato per direttissima.
quote_translation: The prison police of the institution managed to arrest whoever piloted the drone, a 28-year-old from the Salerno area, already tried by fast-track procedure.

summary: Lithuanian police and prosecutors arrested 27 people, 13 of them police and border guards, in a cigarette-smuggling operation centred on weather balloons. Searches found equipment including thermal imagers, drones and GPS transmitters.
source_title: Wielka operacja służb w Solecznikach. 27 zatrzymanych, w tym funkcjonariusze policji
quote: W tym tygodniu służby przeprowadziły kilka operacji, podczas których znaleziono sprzęt wykorzystywany do przemytu kontrabandy: termowizory, drony, nadajniki GPS, środki łączności radiowej, maski na twarz oraz urządzenia do pakowania papierosów.
quote_translation: This week the services carried out several operations in which equipment used for smuggling contraband was found: thermal imagers, drones, GPS transmitters, radio communication equipment, face masks and cigarette packing devices.

summary: Around 20:00 prison police detected a drone over the detention area trying to release a package from outside the perimeter; the drone was not downed but the load was recovered.
payload_detail: package contents not stated in the text seen
source_title: Drone con droga e cellulari nel carcere: la Polizia Penitenziaria sventa il traffico illecito
quote: Tentativo di introduzione di materiale illecito sventato
quote_translation: Attempt to introduce illicit material foiled

summary: Home-made uncrewed submersible shaped like a small car found adrift in the Strait of Gibraltar and seized by the Guardia Civil; no drugs found. Authorities link it to drug trafficking.
payload_detail: no drugs found in or around the craft
source_title: Un dron submarino con forma de coche, localizado a la deriva en el Estrecho
quote: Las autoridades investigan ahora su origen , su sistema de navegación y si forma parte de una red organizada de transporte de estupefacientes mediante tecnología submarina no tripulada .
quote_translation: Authorities are now investigating its origin, its navigation system and whether it is part of an organised drug-transport network using uncrewed underwater technology.

summary: Prison police seized 200 g of drugs and 17 phones at Poggioreale; 3 phones found in the exercise yard were probably delivered by drone.
payload_detail: 200 g drugs, 17 phones (3 in yard presumed by drone)
source_title: Drone porta 17 cellulari e droga nel carcere di Poggioreale - ANSA
quote: 14 nei padiglioni detentivi e 3 nella zona dei passeggi, questi ultimi verosimilmente recapitati via drone
quote_translation: 14 in the detention wings and 3 in the exercise yard, the latter probably delivered by drone.

place: St Brigid's Place, Portlaoise, Co. Laois
summary: Gardaí investigating a drone over St Brigid's Place, Portlaoise, stopped a car, arrested two men aged 36 and 43 and recovered a drone in a field; phones were reportedly found. Released, investigation ongoing.
payload_detail: phones reportedly found
source_title: Two arrested after drone seized near prison in Laois
quote: Gardaí arrested two men and seized a drone following a suspected attempt to fly contraband into Portlaoise Prison.

summary: Two men aged 20 and 22 were caught during a night drone delivery to Douai prison, launching from the garden of one of them in Cuincy, and were later convicted.
source_title: À Cuincy, son jardin servait de piste de décollage aux drones chargés de livrer les colis à la maison d’arrêt - La Voix du Nord
quote: Deux hommes de 20 et 22 ans ont été condamnés pour avoir livré des colis, par drone, à la maison d’arrêt de Douai.
quote_translation: Two men aged 20 and 22 have been convicted of delivering parcels by drone to the Douai remand prison.

summary: Police stopped a van in Salford less than a mile from HMP Manchester and found occupants and a large drone. Multiple drops that evening; one package delivered, one intercepted. Three people sentenced 17 September 2026 at Manchester Crown Court; one also charged with supply of Class A drugs.
payload_detail: drugs and other prohibited items; quantities not given
source_title: Three people jailed over drone plot to smuggle drugs into HMP Manchester
quote: Greater Manchester Police said that multiple drone drops had taken place at the prison that evening, and one package had been successfully delivered whilst another intercepted by prison staff.

place: Centro Penitenciario de Alhaurín de la Torre, Málaga
summary: Drone seen over Alhaurín de la Torre prison in daylight at 18:30, passing modules 2 and 5 and the infirmary; union could not verify any payload.

quote_translation: TAMPM denounced at the time, noting that the aircraft was sighted at 18:30, which increases security risks.

place: Prison d'Elsau and Hautepierre hospital heliport, Strasbourg
summary: Night drone deliveries to Elsau prison, Strasbourg, entered the Hautepierre hospital heliport zone: 19 flights detected since April, two July incidents blocked helicopter landings; night landings suspended from 28 July.
source_title: Drones hacia una prisión dejan a un hospital sin helipuerto - Euronews.com
quote: En los últimos años este método de 'reparto' se ha extendido en todas las cárceles de Francia, y la de Estrasburgo no es una excepción.
quote_translation: In recent years this 'delivery' method has spread to all prisons in France, and Strasbourg's is no exception.

payload_detail: 3 smartphones, 200 g hashish, 4 g crack

quote_translation: Carabinieri of the Naples provincial command seized a drone with a nylon line tied to a bag with three smartphones, 200 g hashish and four of crack, drugs destined for inmates.

summary: Border Guard officers from Bobrowniki detained two Belarusian and one Polish national collecting contraband flown from Belarus by drones: four packages of cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps worth about PLN 95,000. Charged; three months' pretrial detention.
payload_detail: 4 packages of cigarettes, approx PLN 95,000

quote: Funkcjonariusze z Placówki SG w Bobrownikach zatrzymali 2 obywateli Białorusi oraz 1 obywatela Polski, którzy w rejon miejscowości przygranicznych przyjechali celem odebrania kontrabandy przemyconej z Białorusi do Polski, za pomocą bezzałogowych statków powietrznych tzw. dronów.
quote_translation: Officers from the Bobrowniki SG post detained 2 Belarusian citizens and 1 Polish citizen who came to border localities to collect contraband smuggled from Belarus to Poland by unmanned aircraft, so-called drones.

place: forests of Białystok county, trial at Sąd Okręgowy w Białymstoku

payload_detail: 4,600 packs of Belarusian cigarettes without Polish excise stamps
source_title: Proces oskarżonych o przemyt dronami nielegalnych papierosów. Nie przyznają się do winy

quote_translation: The local district prosecutor's office charged them with taking part in illegally bringing 4,600 packs of Belarusian cigarettes without Polish excise stamps into Poland by drone.

summary: Several network-linked people were arrested in the Stockholm area; per unnamed sources a device for dropping hand grenades from a drone was found with three of them. quote_translation: According to information given to Aftonbladet, police are said to have found a kind of device for a drone that could be used to drop hand grenades.

payload_detail: up to 12 cases per night; 34 packages seized

quote: the perpetrators managed to transport up to 12 cases of cigarettes. During the inspection of the scene, detectives seized 34 packages of cigarettes without excise tax stamps, 2 unmanned aerial vehicles, and a launcher.

payload_detail: controlled drugs valued €7,000

quote: Elles "constatent la présence d'un sac contenant un drone ainsi que des produits stupéfiants". Les trois occupants sont donc placés en garde à vue.
quote_translation: They found a bag containing a drone and narcotics. The three occupants were placed in custody.

quote: En organiseret bande, der brugte droner til at smugle narkotika og mobiltelefoner ind i fængsler i London, er afsløret og idømt tilsammen 22 års fængsel.
quote_translation: An organised gang that used drones to smuggle narcotics and mobile phones into prisons in London has been exposed and sentenced to 22 years in prison in total.

place: General Detention Facility of Trikala, Trikala
summary: Between 02:30 and 03:30 guards saw a drone over the prison perimeter that tried to drop a package of mobile phones and accessories into the yard; anti-drone systems downed it in a nearby field.

payload_detail: class B drugs, mobile phones, chargers, SIM cards
source_title: Harrow men jailed after running drone drug drops into London prisons
quote: Men from Harrow are among a seven-person gang jailed after using drones to smuggle drugs and mobile phones into prisons across London.

quote: le modèle découvert le mois dernier en perquisition dans une maison isolée de Vélez-Málaga en Andalousie, un Mugin 4 450 VTOL made in China, pouvait remplir ces conditions.
quote_translation: the model found last month in a search of an isolated house in Vélez-Málaga, Andalusia, a Chinese-made Mugin 4 450 VTOL, could meet these conditions.

summary: A drone delivered a football sock of phones, cannabis and tobacco to a third-floor cell window at HMP Peterborough. A woman was traced via the inmate's calls, arrested and pleaded guilty; suspended sentence.
payload_detail: 10 miniature phones, a Zanco phone, cannabis, 6 packs of tobacco, 7 packs cigarette papers
source_title: Woman smuggled sock stuffed with phones and drugs via drone into prison | ITV News - ITVX
quote: Prison officers noticed the drone heading towards a third-floor window where the inmate took it through a hole in his window.

summary: Prison police noticed a drone approaching cell windows at Frosinone prison; it carried three mobile phones. The operator was not identified.
payload_detail: three mobile phones
source_title: Provincia di Frosinone – Droni per portare telefonini ai detenuti. La scoperta degli agenti di custodia del carcere del capoluogo
quote: Nel drone erano contenuti tre cellulari ma non si è riusciti a scoprire chi fosse, all’esterno della struttura penitenziaria, a manovrare il velivolo.
quote_translation: The drone contained three mobile phones but it was not possible to find out who was operating the aircraft outside the prison.

summary: Kuźnica Border Guard patrol saw a drone from Belarus drop a load 900 m from the border and turn back. Three people collecting it fled by car; the Polish driver tried to ram officers. 2,000 packs of unstamped cigarettes (about PLN 30,000) seized; two Belarusians and one Pole charged.
payload_detail: 2,000 packs cigarettes without Polish excise stamps, nearly PLN 30,000
source_title: Udaremniono przemyt przy użyciu drona
quote: Patrol Straży Granicznej z Kuźnicy zauważył lecący obiekt z Białorusi do Polski. Ustalono, że był to bezzałogowy statek powietrzny tzw. dron, który w odległości 900 metrów od granicy państwa zrzucił ładunek i zawrócił na Białoruś.
quote_translation: A Border Guard patrol from Kuźnica noticed an object flying from Belarus to Poland. It was established to be an unmanned aircraft, a so-called drone, which dropped its load 900 metres from the border and turned back to Belarus.

summary: Commissariato Vicaria Mercato arrested a 43-year-old under house arrest who used a drone from his terrace to monitor police and Carabinieri movements; 130 g heroin and 1,755 euro found. Investigators did not rule out drone deliveries to customers.
payload_detail: 130 g heroin (found at home, not on the drone)
source_title: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
quote: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
quote_translation: Naples: used a drone to monitor Police and Carabinieri movements, pusher arrested

place: Rivne section, Lutsk Border Detachment, Volyn Oblast
summary: Around midnight border guards found a UAV and a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes prepared for transfer to the Polish side; a separate patrol found 2,000 packs moved from Belarus by a purpose-built device.
payload_detail: 500 packs prepared for transfer
source_title: На Волині затримали безпілотник, який мав перевезти сигарети до Польщі (фото)
quote: близько опівночі військовослужбовці відділу «Рівне», реалізовуючи оперативну інформацію, виявили в прикордонні безпілотний літальний апарат. Поряд знаходився пакунок з 500 пачками сигарет
quote_translation: around midnight, servicemen of the Rivne unit, acting on operational information, found an unmanned aerial vehicle in the border area. Next to it was a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes.

summary: National police intercepted a drone carrying one kilo of Moroccan hashish that lost control and landed on a ship roof at the Tarajal polygon, Ceuta. Drone and drugs seized; investigation opened.
payload_detail: 1 kg hashish
source_title: Un drone transportant un kilo de haschich marocain intercepté à Ceuta
quote: La police nationale a intercepté lundi, un drone transportant un kilo de haschich marocain.
quote_translation: The national police intercepted on Monday a drone carrying one kilo of Moroccan hashish.

place: Naples base; deliveries to 18 prisons incl. Secondigliano, Frosinone, Cosenza, Siracusa, Augusta, Catania, Rovigo, Trapani, Saluzzo, Sulmona
summary: Naples DDA operation: 31 people subject to two custody orders (20 + 11, Polizia di Stato and prison police). Network supplied phones, drugs and firearms to prisons by drone, paid by camorra organisations; investigation began April 2021. A 52-year-old modified drones to carry more weight.
payload_detail: phones, drugs, firearms (quantities not in release)
source_title: Armi, droga e telefoni in carcere con i droni, 31 arresti a Napoli
quote: Tentativo di introduzione di materiale illecito sventato
quote_translation: Attempt to introduce illicit material foiled

place: Prisons at Veenhuizen, Krimpen aan den IJssel and Almelo
summary: Court in Dordrecht convicted a 34-year-old man from Rijsenhout, by plea agreement, of delivering drugs and phones to prisoners by drone. Prosecutors counted about 70 flights over 2021-2024 in NL, BE and LU; convicted for hashish at Veenhuizen and three iPhones at Krimpen and Almelo.
payload_detail: about 100 g hashish (Veenhuizen); packages with three iPhones (Krimpen aan den IJssel, Almelo)
source_title: Man (34) dropt drugs en telefoons in gevangenissen met drone, krijgt taakstraf
quote: Volgens justitie maakte S. tussen april 2021 en februari 2024 zeventig vluchten met drones om verboden goederen af te leveren aan gevangenen in Nederland, België en Luxemburg.
quote_translation: According to prosecutors, S. made seventy drone flights between April 2021 and February 2024 to deliver prohibited goods to prisoners in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.

summary: Second of three attempts to deliver drugs into HMP Gartree, by drone, arranged between an outside associate and an inmate using a phone. Unsuccessful. Associate arrested 13 Oct 2021; sentenced 28 Jun 2024 to 5 years consecutive on the prison-conveyance count.
payload_detail: unquantified Class A and B drugs; attempt unsuccessful
source_title: R v Mohammed Jakir Hussain [2025] EWCA Crim 419
quote: The second attempt took place on 31 March 2021, this time involving the use of a drone. The appellant and the inmate discussed test flights and used internet searches to research the payload and how to modify the device to make less noise when being used to deliver drugs into the prison.

summary: Three men tried to deliver nitrous oxide cartridges to Périgueux prison by drone from a neighbouring car park; police found them near a car with about twenty cartridges; two convicted, one minor not tried.
payload_detail: about twenty nitrous oxide (cream-charger) cartridges, too heavy for the drone
source_title: Dordogne : jugés pour avoir tenté de livrer du gaz hilarant en prison avec un drone - Sud Ouest
quote: Trois hommes ont tenté d’utiliser un drone pour livrer du gaz hilarant à la prison de Périgueux, en Dordogne. Deux ont été condamnés
quote_translation: Three men tried to use a drone to deliver laughing gas to Périgueux prison. Two were convicted.

summary: Guardia Civil and Policía Nacional operation in Ceuta against drone-based drug trafficking from Morocco; one person arrested, documents seized. Follows a drone with drugs found on a Ceuta mountain in late summer 2020.
source_title: Des drones pour transporter la drogue entre le Maroc et Ceuta - Bladi.net
quote: Pour contourner la fermeture de la frontière entre Ceuta et le Maroc, les trafiquants de drogue marocains utilisent des drones pour introduire de la drogue en Espagne.
quote_translation: To get around the closure of the border between Ceuta and Morocco, Moroccan drug traffickers use drones to bring drugs into Spain.

summary: Guardia Civil and Policía Nacional joint operation in El Príncipe, Ceuta: four arrested, four semi-industrial drones (up to 25 kg payload) and three commercial drones seized from a hashish-smuggling group flying from Morocco; group also used drones to follow police cars.
payload_detail: hashish up to 25 kg per flight; 1,920 rivotril tablets seized ready for transport to Morocco
source_title: Derribando los drones del hachís: se han detectado aparatos de 20.000 euros que pueden pasar hasta 25 kilos en cada vuelo - El Mundo
quote: El operativo culminó con cuatro personas detenidas. A la organización fundada por Yalal El loco se le intervino cuatro drones semiidustriales con capacidad de carga de hasta 25 kilos y otros tres comerciales con menores prestaciones.
quote_translation: The operation ended with four people arrested. From the organisation founded by 'Yalal El Loco', four semi-industrial drones with load capacity up to 25 kg and three commercial ones with lower performance were seized.

place: HMP Risley, Warrington (drone flights); raids in Crewe and Alsager
summary: Cheshire Police raided addresses in Crewe and Alsager and seized four drones, controller, batteries and drugs from a shed, ending a drone conspiracy supplying HMP Risley. Seven defendants pleaded guilty; sentenced at Liverpool Crown Court.
payload_detail: ketamine, cocaine, MDMA, cannabis, mobile phones, SIM cards
source_title: Inmate integral to prison drone-drug conspiracy is handed more time behind bars - Warrington Guardian
quote: Ketamine, cocaine, MDMA and cannabis, with a street value of around £8,000 and prison value of around £78,200, were seized from a shed, as well as four drones, a controller and batteries.

summary: Squadra mobile of Treviso arrested a 38-year-old for heroin dealing; a drone was reportedly used to reach customers waiting near his house. Date is the arrest date.
source_title: Follina, consegne con il drone e la casa per consumare eroina e coca - Corriere del Veneto
quote: Erano arrivati perfino ad utilizzare un drone che raggiungeva il cliente, il quale restava solitamente in attesa, nei paraggi dell’abitazione
quote_translation: They had even used a drone that reached the customer, who usually waited near the house.

place: St John's Square near Portlaoise Prison, Co. Laois
summary: Gardaí seized a drone with a package of phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis (about €5,000) near Portlaoise Prison and arrested a man in his 20s. He was charged on 8 Jan 2021 and bailed on condition he not fly drones near places of detention.
payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine, cannabis; est. €5,000
source_title: Drone and drugs seized by Garda in Portlaoise 6/1/21 arrest
quote: Gardaí have arrested a man in his 20s following the seizure of a drone along with a package containing mobile phones, chargers and quantities of crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis, with a combined estimated value of €5,000 (analysis pending).

summary: Police found a group receiving alpha-PVP sent by drone from Ivangorod, Russia, across the Narva river into Narva; six such deliveries were found in the investigation and the group was caught on the sixth. Four people were suspected, three in custody.
payload_detail: alpha-PVP (quantity not stated)
source_title: Politsei tabas mullu Narvas kaks droone kasutanud salakaubavedajate gruppi
quote: Narkootikumid saadeti Ivangorodist drooniga üle Narva jõe Narva linna. Meie avastasime kriminaalmenetluse käigus kuus sellist korda. Kuuendal korral pidasime nad kinni.
quote_translation: The drugs were sent from Ivangorod by drone across the Narva river to the town of Narva. We found six such occasions in the criminal proceedings. On the sixth occasion we detained them.

summary: 25 drone drop-offs at Midlands prisons delivering heroin, cannabis and spice ordered by inmates; two defendants pleaded guilty, two found guilty at Coventry Crown Court; sentencing pending.
payload_detail: heroin, cannabis, spice, tens of thousands of pounds
source_title: Inmates are having Mounjaro delivered to their cells using drones, says prison governor - The Independent
quote: The police detected 25 drone drop offs at prisons across the Midlands containing tens of thousands of pounds of heroin, cannabis and spice, ordered directly by inmates.

place: HMP Onley, Rugby, and HMP Gartree, Leicestershire
summary: Three men jailed at Wolverhampton Crown Court (6y6m, 5y6m, 7y3m) and a former Staffordshire Police detective constable given a suspended two-year sentence, for drone drops of drugs, tobacco and phones into HMP Onley and HMP Gartree in 2021-2022.
payload_detail: Class A and B drugs, tobacco, phones; one package heroin and cannabis
source_title: Smugglers jailed for using drones to drop contraband into prison near Rugby
quote: Let this case send a clear message to anyone thinking of engaging in similar behaviour

summary: Hungarian tax and customs authority (NAV) and police met smugglers using drones and unmanned aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian green border, tracked them by thermal camera, and seized over 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two aircraft.
payload_detail: more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes
source_title: Cigarettacsempészet drónnal
quote: A légi eszközöket az orgazdák az ukrán-magyar határnál vetették be, a pénzügyőrök pedig hőkamerákkal követték útjukat. Ennek eredményeképpen több mint 6700 doboz cigarettát és két gépet találtak és foglaltak le.
quote_translation: The smugglers used the aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian border and customs officers tracked them with thermal cameras. As a result, more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two machines were found and seized.

summary: A gun was delivered by drone to a Camorra-linked inmate in Frosinone prison, who then fired a shot in a revenge shooting over a beating.
source_title: Andrea Kercanaj, dallo spaccio agli spari in carcere: rimpatriato il boss albanese di Frosinone - Il Messaggero
quote: Nel 2021, restò coinvolto in una sparatoria. A fare fuoco, con un'arma recapitata poco prima con un drone
quote_translation: In 2021 he was involved in a shooting. The shooter, with a weapon delivered shortly before by drone

place: PI Lelystad, PI Veenhuizen, PI Zaandam (also prisons in Belgium and Luxembourg)
summary: Three men from Amsterdam, Schiedam and Rijsenhout arrested 5 March 2024 on suspicion of criminal organisation; on order they flew drugs and phones by drone to inmates since 2021, incl. one phone delivered to a cell window. Drones, parts and drugs seized.
source_title: Drugs en telefoons via drones in gevangenissen gedropt - Politie.nl
quote: Op dinsdag 5 maart zijn drie mannen aangehouden die verdacht worden van deelname aan een criminele organisatie. De verdachten zouden de drugs en telefoons op bestelling afleveren in verschillende penitentiaire inrichtingen (PI).
quote_translation: On Tuesday 5 March three men were arrested on suspicion of participating in a criminal organisation. The suspects allegedly delivered drugs and telephones to order at several prisons.
